meta.title: 这套动作教程来啦！
meta.title_en: This Dance Move Tutorial Is Here!

scenes.title_en: Opening: Arm Position and Hair Flick
scenes.context: 博主示范舞蹈起式：另一只手放上面或下面都可以，配合抛头发打开画面。
sentences: 另一只手放上面放下面都可以。
Your other hand can go on top or below.
on top or below（上面或下面）
paraphrase: 换种说法表达手位自由
Put your free hand wherever feels natural — above or below.
Toss your hair to open up the shot.
scenes.speak: Your other hand can go on top or below. Flick your hair to open up the shot.

scenes.title_cn: 空间动作：扶墙与甩手抬腿转
scenes.title_en: Spatial Move: Wall Support and Kick-Turn
scenes.context: 一只手扶墙作为支点，甩手同时抬腿转身，注意摆臂抬腿的配合。
sentences: Rest one hand on the wall.
Swing your arm and kick as you turn.
Keep your arm swing and kick in sync.
paraphrase: 换种说法表达扶墙支点
Use the wall as your support point.
换种说法表达动作同步
Make sure your arms and legs move together.
scenes.speak: Rest one hand on the wall. Swing your arm and kick as you turn. Keep your arm swing and kick in sync.

scenes.context: 侧身抬腿转衔接前一动作，接一个抛头发打招呼的收尾，节奏轻快。
sentences: Turn sideways and lift your leg.
Flick your hair as a greeting.
paraphrase: Twist to the side as you raise your leg.
换种说法表达收尾动作
End it with a hair flick like a wave.
scenes.speak: Turn sideways and lift your leg. End it with a hair flick like a wave.

scenes.context: 博主提示收藏视频跟着学，并请求关注。
sentences: 收藏起来你就学一学吧。
Save this and give it a try.
paraphrase: 换种说法表达收藏跟练
Bookmark this video and practice along.
scenes.speak: Save this and give it a try. Don't forget to hit follow.

practice: 用「on top or below」表达手位

Keep your arm swing and kick in sync.
Turn sideways and lift your leg.

pitfalls: 把手硬性固定在一个位置
手位本来就自由，上放下放都行
动作教学的松弛感来自手位灵活
转身时手臂与腿各动各的
同步才好看，各动各的显僵硬
首尾呼应让整套动作完整
shifts: 把舞蹈动作当复杂套路
每个小动作单独练熟再串
追求每个动作一模一样
手位、幅度可微调，自然更重要
